notes: Program pages on grad.ucla.edu load their requirements by JavaScript, so all were fetched with --render. English minimums (TOEFL 87 / 4.5 on the new scale, IELTS 7.0) come from the UCLA-wide English Requirements page and China's 80/100 minimum from the Required Academic Records page; the program pages point to 'UCLA's minimum requirements'. Seven programs state their own higher English score and use it instead. Deadlines without a year (MBA, M.Q.E., M.S.S., M.A.S.D.S., Data Science in Biomedicine, MRED primary round) are left out; all pages are listed under 'Fall' intake as stated. PhD-only and doctoral-track-only pages, the online M.S. in Engineering series, arts, nursing and the arts-based M.F.A. were not collected; Mathematics M.A. says 'Not currently accepting applications'.
